claimedSlice: opencv2/cudabgsegm.hpp parser-backed CUDA background-segmentation declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaBgSegm wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudabgsegm module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS; real execution depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime.

The module is layered on opencv_video background-subtractor contracts and requires GpuMat/Stream data, asynchronous execution policy, and persistent background-model state; this package ships no CUDA background-segmentation wrapper/runtime.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.

The CUDA background-segmentation surface in cv::cuda has no native CudaBgSegm wrapper entrypoint or managed public owner in the current package; OpenCV disables the module on iOS and unless CUDA or CUDA stubs are enabled, while execution requires an external CUDA toolkit/runtime. GpuMat/Stream ownership, asynchronous execution, and background-model state remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic smoke contract.
